- Each Markdown-formatted document submitted will be processed as a distinct content asset, corresponding to a new article. These articles shall be systematically ingested and stored within the designated directory named `articles` as json file.
- Use the interfaces defined in `types/` to get the json schema
- All bullet points must match the type from `types/article/BulletListContent` where every paragraph above the bullet points must be what you will define as `content`
- Upon creation, the new file artifact shall be assigned a filename consisting of a universally unique identifier (UUID) string. This same UUID string will serve as the primary identifier (ID) for the corresponding new article entity.
- A new JSON object, instantiated according to the ArticlePreview type definition imported from the types/article.ts module, must be appended to the index.json file located within the articles directory. It is imperative that this indexed object utilizes the identical UUID that serves as the primary identifier (ID) for the corresponding article, ensuring referential integrity.
- For any associated image asset with name "article_image", its filename shall be constructed by concatenating the corresponding article's UUID (serving as the article ID), a '\_img' suffix, and a '.jpg' file extension. This standardized naming convention will ensure a direct and unambiguous linkage between the article and its related image.
